provenance.source: PR #11768 Validate model sql file provided config, merged 2025-06-25
provenance.note: at this head parse_python_model records config_keys_used and config_keys_defaults in _config_call_dict only when the model calls dbt.config.get, and validate_model_config returns early unless DBT_ENV_PRIVATE_RUN_JSONSCHEMA_VALIDATIONS is set; when both hold, every key the model read is validated as user-written config and raises custom-key-in-config-deprecation (#12314), because those two bookkeeping keys are not in ModelPropertiesConfigs; the fix passes is_python_model and skips them

keywords: validates keys the user never wrote
warns for keys the model read
bugs.note: validate_model_config sees the keys a python model read with dbt.config.get in _config_call_dict and validates them as user config, so a custom-key-in-config deprecation is raised for keys the user never wrote; it only runs with DBT_ENV_PRIVATE_RUN_JSONSCHEMA_VALIDATIONS set, and the fix passes is_python_model and skips config_keys_used and config_keys_defaults
